title: Meerkats Platform Capabilities v1 — contract for platform_heuristics/<platform>/capabilities.json
description: The automation surface of one platform: which entities exist for selection, which operations are legal per entity (an informative MIRROR of the capability registry's operation_bindings — the registry stays authoritative, and the gate script cross-checks every entity.operation pair against it), the guards the binder enforces at config creation, and the alert-layer notes. Keys starting with _ are mirror metadata (ci/mirror.py) and always allowed.

entities.description: canonical DSL ids for selection_request.entity and registry binding keys

additionalProperties.description: operation names per entity; each <entity>.<operation> must exist in the registry's operation_bindings for this platform (gate-enforced). An EMPTY list is a deliberate declaration: the entity exists but has ZERO bindable operations — everything on it fails closed (e.g. flipkart campaigns: no public ads API, alert-only)

automation_guards.description: when an operation is LEGAL AND WISE — enforced by the binder at config creation
